citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 12:40pm on 10
August 2026. A representative at the facility was not able to access all required paperwork to conduct a complete
inspection. The licensee was not reachable by phone at work. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and
records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may
result in enforcement action.
End Section
